_note: Only approved:true sources are fetched/published. Re-review terms before enabling. Items marked needs_legal_review must not be enabled until a qualified professional confirms.

sources.name: Hacker News (official API)
sources.permitted_usage: Public API; store title, link, score, time. Link to original; no article text copied.
sources.attribution: Link to original publisher and 'via Hacker News'
sources.rate_limit: Polite: <=90 requests per run, once a day

sources.name: arXiv (RSS)
sources.permitted_usage: arXiv states metadata (title, abstract, authors) is CC0; papers themselves carry per-paper licenses - link only, never copy PDFs/figures.
sources.attribution: Credit arXiv and link to abstract page
sources.rate_limit: RSS updates once daily; fetch once per run

sources.name: NASA News (RSS)
sources.permitted_usage: NASA states its content is generally in the public domain unless marked otherwise. We use only title, short excerpt and link. Images and third-party material are NOT reused.
sources.commercial_use: generally allowed for NASA-created content (third-party material excluded)
sources.attribution: Credit NASA and link to the original page
sources.image_rights: Only images hosted on nasa.gov, shown with credit. NASA says its content is generally not copyrighted, but some images carry third-party credits. Takedown process applies.
sources.review_note: Re-check NASA media usage guidelines periodically; remove an image on any rights-holder request.
